body.statement: Theorem 1 of Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Leh\'ericy states that in their two-replicate additive model, condition (H2) for each latent signal and coordinate independence (H1) for each error law make equality of observed convolution laws identify both the latent-signal law and the error law up to translation.

source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 1. Assume that X and X' satisfy (H2) and epsilon ~ Q, epsilon-tilde ~ Q-tilde satisfy (H1). Then P_{r(X)} * Q = P_{r(X')} * Q-tilde implies P_X = P_{X'} and Q = Q-tilde up to translation.

upstream.locator: Theorem 1, PDF page 3; H1-H2 on PDF pages 2-3

attestation.note: Verified directly against arXiv:2409.02014v1, PDF page 3, lines 131-132 in the retrieved text view on 2026-09-10; the preceding page defines H1 as coordinate independence and H2 as the stated Laplace-growth condition.
